reviews.comment: Bahut hi premium phone hai! Battery life kamaal ki hai aur camera quality top notch.
Display quality super smooth hai. thoda mehnga hai par features mast hain.
Bass sound quality is very good. ANC makes a huge difference while traveling.
Authentic leather design, premium finish. It has plenty of card slots.
